references: GRCh38 primary assembly FASTA + .fai + BWA index

reconstruction_stages.caveat: bcftools alone is NOT a valid somatic caller (no tumor-vs-normal model); requires Mutect2 (gatk4) or Strelka2
reconstruction_stages.reason: missing tool(s): need [gatk OR strelka] on PATH
reconstruction_stages.install_hint: conda install -c bioconda gatk4   # Mutect2 tumor-vs-normal; or bioconda strelka

references: GRCh38 + GENCODE annotation + Ensembl VEP cache
reconstruction_stages.produces: full class-I 8-11mer candidate universe (the SHARED denominator for both arms)
reconstruction_stages.reason: missing tool(s): need [pvacseq OR pvactools] on PATH
reconstruction_stages.install_hint: pip install pvactools && conda install -c bioconda ensembl-vep   # + VEP cache

reconstruction_stages.produces: genuine PRIME AND frozen Epicurus ranks over the IDENTICAL candidate universe
